notes: The ensō: hold Tab (or LB) and a brushed circle draws itself with your tools around it: brush, horse, dog sled, lantern, Finder, scroll. Q (or X) uses the one you picked. The horse is now scribbled into the world in ink, you hop up onto it, and getting off crumples it into a paper ball. Dog sleds: four paper dogs pull you across the snow; hold run while turning to drift. You crumple on big drops, fold a paper crane if you stand still long enough, and flutter in blizzards. Hold the lantern high for more light. Full controller: A interact, B roll/run, X tool, Y horse, LB ensō, RB Finder, LT scroll, Back journal, R3 re-centre camera; the journal and scroll work with a controller too. The app now checks for updates 20 seconds after it opens and every 5 minutes.
